profile.grounding_note: Simulated coaching profile grounded in real StudentLife pre-term surveys (PSS=18.0, PHQ-9=5.0, UCLA Loneliness=37.0, PHQ-9 item 9=0, Extraversion=4.0, Neuroticism=2.88, Conscientiousness=2.56); courses: GERM 001, COSC 065, COSC 007.
goals: Protect at least 6.5-7 hours of sleep instead of pulling late-night all-nighters before CS and German deadlines
Break up heavy assignment and lab nights into manageable evening blocks
Unwind with calm solo routines (music or tea) when feeling drained

preferences.activity_style: Calm solo wind-downs (listening to music, short tea break, light stretching)

constraints: Takes 3 courses (GERM 001, COSC 065, COSC 007) with frequent weekly deadlines
Often works late in the evening and naps in the afternoon

episodes.final_message: Midterms week with deadlines today and more coming up is a lot to handle, especially when you're feeling so sleepy. Before you dive back into your CS or German work, why not take a 5-minute break to step away from your screen, stretch, or grab a cup of tea? It might help you recharge a bit before your next study block.
